projects.title: Grounded Portfolio AI Representative
projects.problem: A static portfolio cannot answer follow-up recruiter questions or explain project context interactively.
projects.approach: Built a Gemini-powered agent behind a serverless Python API on Vercel using a curated knowledge base injected directly into the system instruction rather than adding a vector database or RAG layer, streaming responses via generate_content_stream() and browser TextDecoder.
projects.outcome_and_boundaries: Provides grounded answers constrained by documented context and instructions, with ~400 ms reported first-chunk time in project measurements and documented checks for unknown info and prompt injection.

projects.title: AI Usage Metering & Billing Engine
projects.problem: AI platforms require tenant-aware usage records, quota enforcement, and subscription transitions not reliant on browser redirects.
projects.approach: Built a FastAPI service backed by PostgreSQL and Redis with idempotent usage recording, quota checks, and Flutterwave sandbox webhooks so subscription activation depends on verified provider events.
projects.outcome_and_boundaries: 32 automated tests passed in ~1.3 seconds; uses Flutterwave sandbox with production reconciliation and operational hardening left as future work.

projects.title: The Polite Scraper
projects.problem: Repeatedly fetching unchanged catalogue pages wastes requests and slows small data-collection runs.
projects.approach: Used lightweight HTML parsing with request delays, timeouts, SHA-256 caching, and Pydantic validation.
projects.outcome_and_boundaries: Recorded warm-cache run achieved 63/63 cache hits in 2.82 seconds across 60 catalogue records (warm-cache result, not a cold-scrape benchmark).

projects.title: Task Management & Authentication API
projects.problem: Task endpoints need persistent storage and authentication boundaries rather than in-memory CRUD alone.
projects.approach: Progressed from prototypes to a FastAPI service with PostgreSQL persistence and Supabase JWT authentication.
projects.outcome_and_boundaries: Demonstrates persistent, authenticated task API design; logout and token-revocation behaviour remain to be verified before stronger security claims.

projects.title: E-commerce State Synchronization
projects.problem: Out-of-order asynchronous responses can overwrite newer client state with stale data.
projects.approach: Explored request-sequence guards so arrival order does not commit stale responses over newer state.
projects.outcome_and_boundaries: Captures the correctness principle ('arrival order is not authority to commit'); implementation snippet and reproducible test still to be attached.
